# Provenance

This paired task is a compact derivative of the MIT-licensed storefronts in
`https://github.com/SimYunSup/kudzu-based-bench` at commit
`f2d5be1a516c539e30f7125f6870d42b1dd02ecd`. It retains product option,
derived price/availability, cart, checkout, responsive, and static-route roles
while reducing catalog and presentation volume equally for both frameworks.
